fields.statement: At 0b903288, with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset: `go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(health|describe-golden)$' -count=1 -v` passes both. health.txtar covers each acceptance point: no daemon is warn with 'start it with rhiza daemon'; RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=100 makes disk bad and health exits 1; a dirty main is warn; a failed inbox run is warn ('1 waiting: 1 failed'); a model problem makes check bad; health --json and api call health are compared with cmp (ok and bad cases). describe-golden.txtar holds the health op. Attempt 1's finding is fixed: 0b903288 lands the missing actor records and re-renders, and `make check` now exits 0 with a clean tree afterwards.
